text:
alex: thinking out loud  we need a tiny policy DSL for sampling visibility tied to quota changes. current hacky flags are messy in console. suggestions?
priya: +1. want to be able to express "1% of tenants in beta OR routes with /preview" and a hard cap per-route. DSL makes the console readable.
julius: watch out for PII. sampling should go through scrubber stage before storage and we need a redact whitelist.
sasha: agree re scrubber. also add a dry-run mode where we only emit telemetry (no stored payload) to validate policy impact.
alex: proto DSL sketch: ```yaml
policy: sampling_ballot_v1
rules:
  - name: beta_preview
    rate: 0.01
    match: tenant.tier == "beta" or route.path starts_with("/preview")
    per_route_cap: 500
    dry_run: true
```
priya: nice. per_route_cap default should be 1000 for hosted canary, lower for private.
julius: telemetry model: emit two events per sampled request: `sample.evaluated` (no payload) and `sample.stored` (payload omitted in metrics). store only a pointer id in metrics.
ops-bot: note: need shard-level backpressure. recommend circuit: if storage_write_latency > 75ms for 30s -> disable storing on that shard, keep eval-only.
sasha: console UX: show policy preview with estimated QPS impact and an "estimated storage" column. owners should be able to toggle dry_run -> store.
alex: API: `POST /internal/v1/samples` accepts batch with `Idempotency-Key`. response 202 with assigned sample ids. storage path should surface a traceable sample_id that is deterministic-ish for repro.
priya: also add feature-flag: `sampling_ballot.enabled:{hosted:true, dedicated:false, private:false}` so customers don't get this by default. opt-in for dedicated/private.
julius: security: scrubber config must be versioned and auditable. also a retention policy: TTL 6h for canary, 30d for debug sinks with explicit approval.
ops-bot: ops runbook stub: auto-unpause after 10m if storage pressure normalizes; manual hard-stop for SEV.
alex: rollout plan: enable DSL UI -> create policy in staging -> dry-run 2h -> canary 1% tenants (dry_run->store) -> monitor sample.write_latency, sample.store_rate, storage_pressure.
deploy-bot: rollout pipeline queued by @alex: staging -> canary -> prod. ETA window: 02:00-05:00 UTC.
sasha: one last UX nit: wording should be "Collect anonymized sample for quota debugging" and explicit reminder: "Do not enable for production traffic without security review."
alex: will write RFC and PR, include sample schema and scrubber rules. tagging @security and @ops for reviews. thanks all.
